description: This Java class 'HonoHttpDevice' simulates an HTTP device that sends various types of messages (events and telemetry) to the Hono platform, including handling command responses and message sequencing.

classes.name: HonoHttpDevice
classes.description: A class that simulates an HTTP device for sending messages and handling commands via Hono platform.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that creates an instance and initiates data sending, then closes Vertx after a delay.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message request to the Hono HTTP adapter and processes the response, including command handling.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a command request with specified status and payload.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sequentially sends predefined requests to the Hono platform.

methods.name: getBasicAuth
methods.description: Generates a Basic Authentication header value for a device.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Creates a username string combining device ID and tenant.
